records.sourceAnchor: Revised scheme guideline reconciled with current eligibility, terms, applicant manual and operational route
observations: PMEGP is a credit-linked margin-money subsidy for eligible new micro-enterprises; the seed dossier keeps subsidy and bank finance in separate value buckets.
The guideline provides subsidy-supported project-cost ceilings of INR 50 lakh for manufacturing and INR 20 lakh for business or service activities, with stated working-capital component limits.
Beneficiary contribution is 10% for the General category and 5% for the Special category; margin-money rates vary by category and rural or urban location.
Existing units under PMRY, REGP or other Government schemes, and units that already received Government subsidy under another scheme, are excluded from the new-unit route.
New PMEGP units must be registered on the Udyam Portal before physical verification and adjustment of margin money in the beneficiary loan account.

Current portal terms state that applications are submitted online, only one person from a family is eligible for new-enterprise assistance, and projects without capital expenditure are not eligible for financing.
The current portal shows 2026-27 operational activity; this supports a live operational route but does not guarantee fund availability, subsidy, bank sanction or processing time.
EDP training, physical verification, three-year margin-money lock and refund conditions remain review-sensitive implementation terms.
The second-loan or upgradation route is distinct from new-unit eligibility and must not be merged into this record.
